title: Stay in the game
changes: New Wardrobe: try horns, hats, wings, cape emblems and staffs on a live 3D warlock, then unlock them with Embers. Looks only, never gameplay.
Browse menus and stats without leaving your lobby. Return in one click; hear when ranked finds players.
The menu now hosts ongoing battles between strong bots.
Your account shares one compact menu card. Lobby chat sits below settings, leaving room for the full player roster.
Spectator bets are easier to find, with visible picks and clear open, locked and closed states.
Leaving after 60 seconds of combat counts as a loss when the match ends, including ranked Elo. Rejoin before the end to recover.
Filter online match history by Casual or Ranked, and inspect saved spells, equipment and upgrades.
See what changed after an update, and browse earlier releases from What's new.
Send bugs or feedback from any menu, with a screenshot and useful game context attached automatically.

title: Sharper opponents
changes: Casual games mix Hard bots with one Brutal and one Medium opponent.
Bots punish warlocks who stand still.
Unattended results close after 30 minutes when nobody is ready.
Spell glows render more efficiently.

title: Fairer ranked results
changes: Ranked Elo follows the overall match result, fixing cases where the winner lost rating because of round survival order.

title: Ready when you are
changes: The next match waits until every human player presses Ready.
New game lets you find another room without waiting for a rematch.
When everyone is ready, the lobby countdown drops to five seconds.

title: Louder hits, clearer results
changes: Fireball and Scourge lead the hotbar, with voiced deaths and clearer kill callouts.
Casual matches play to three round wins.
Match history shows the full standings and earned Embers.
Betting closes earlier as the fight narrows.

title: The first public playtest
changes: Casual and ranked multiplayer across US and European servers.
Accounts, a cosmetic collection and guided practice.
Recover your room after a reload or disconnect.
